evidence.quote: DNA microarray experiment was performed as previously described 6 , on Affymetrix human U133 Plus 2.0 arrays (GeneTitan platform).

evidence.section: Measurement of anti-Diphtheria IgG by Luminex

serum bactericidal titers (SBA).readouts: bactericidal killing titers against meningococcal serogroups

evidence.quote: Continuous titers were determined by interpolation of the serum dilution yielding 50% killing as compared to the T 60 growth control plate average.
